job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions using Python and vector processing techniques to improve data retrieval and augmented reality applications.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI models into existing systems, ensuring seamless integration and optimal performance.
Develop high-quality code that meets industry standards, is well-documented, and easy to maintain.
Troubleshoot issues related to AI model deployment, data quality, and system functionality.

Job Requirements :

5-12 years of experience in developing AI-powered solutions using Python programming language.
Strong understanding of vector processing techniques for image recognition, natural language processing (NLP), or other relevant domains.
Experience with machine learning algorithms such as supervised/unsupervised learning methods.
Proficiency in working with large datasets and ability to analyze complex problems.
